transcript: Japan is one of the most rapidly aging societies in the world The population aged 65 and above already makes up over 28% of the whole A long life is something to be celebrated Yet our society faces new challenges The workforce is declining And the pension system has become harder to sustain Medical costs for older people increase each year Putting pressure on the national budget How to sustain welfare is a common challenge For every developed country The form of the family has also changed More elderly now live apart from their children and grandchildren And a new problem has appeared loneliness Local communities have begun various efforts to support elderly people who live alone Volunteers visit them regularly and care facilities are trying to make up for the shortage of staff with new technology. The mutual support between generations will be the foundation of our future society. The young and the old, each respecting and supporting the other. This is what creates the true richness of a long-lived society.

segments.text: Japan is one of the most rapidly aging societies in the world
The population aged 65 and above already makes up over 28% of the whole
A long life is something to be celebrated
Yet our society faces new challenges
And the pension system has become harder to sustain
Medical costs for older people increase each year
Putting pressure on the national budget
How to sustain welfare is a common challenge
The form of the family has also changed
More elderly now live apart from their children and grandchildren
And a new problem has appeared loneliness
Local communities have begun various efforts to support elderly people who live alone
Volunteers visit them regularly and care facilities are trying to make up for the shortage of staff with new technology.
The mutual support between generations will be the foundation of our future society.
The young and the old, each respecting and supporting the other.
This is what creates the true richness of a long-lived society.
